entries.rule: Chat context, summaries and model memory are never operational authority; only durable pinned repository bytes are.
Exactly one structured action ticket may be valid at a time; zero or multiple actions fail closed.
Free-text next_action fields are advisory only after kernel activation.
XAU parts 001-008 and NQX parts 001-003 are sufficient exact DEV prefixes for FIRST_GATE; remaining full-history parts are not prerequisites for this gate.
The eight already-promoted shards are drained in immutable FIFO order before any new GA1 shard.
A state transition is not promotable until an independent source implementation validates it on an external GitHub Actions runner.
Undefined future scientific criteria become explicit POLICY_REQUIRED blocking states; they may never be inferred from chat history.
Completed valid scientific work is never recomputed solely because a new chat starts.
V243 is an unpromoted rejected architecture candidate; its external run failed during private-repository checkout before kernel validation and it must never become stable authority.
The deterministic compiler and independent oracle must each cover every guard profile, subject selector and success-state selector declared by the active execution map.
Adversarial mutation fixtures must contain all pinned dependencies so each negative case fails because of the intended invariant, not because the fixture is incomplete.
The end-to-end master workgraph is authoritative for stage order. A stage marked POLICY_REQUIRED is a hard deterministic barrier until a versioned contract closes it.
Architecture activation and every later semantic map change require an external clean-runner PASS before stable-pointer promotion.
